title: Weather
summary: The weather where you are, today and the next six days, from Open-Meteo: free, with no key and no account. Set your town on this page and it is kept in step every three hours.
changes: Its Weather widget for Today opens Wide, the smallest a card is drawn at, where it said Small, which Today could not take, and says the sky, the high and the chance of rain, which fit its frame; the low and the town were cut off at its foot.
